newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cenbank drains one-week funds at 29 percent.
newsitem.headline: Czech cenbank drains one-week funds at 29 percent.

text.p: The average yield in a Czech National Bank one-week reverse repo tender to drain funds from the money market yielded the maximum allowable 29 percent, the bank said.
All bids at the maximum yield were accepted, while the minimum accepted bid was 28.90 percent. The limit yield was lowered from Wednesday's 31 percent.

On Thursday, the Czech National Bank reopened its last resort Lombard facility, effective Friday, at an interest rate of 50 percent. The Lombard facility was closed in late May to discourage short-selling of the Czech crown.
